name: strikeglass
description: A local-first, dual-engine Neverwinter combat-log analyzer with verified combat values, customizable analytics widgets, indexed encounter scopes, raw-hit traceability, player comparison, party rotation, and lightweight Canvas charts.
author: Nischhal Raj Subba

scripts.syntax: node --check src/v3/app.js && node --check src/v3/power-drilldown.js && node --check src/v3/charts.js && node --check src/v3/ambient.js && node --check src/v6/dashboard.js && node --check src/v6/dashboard-interactions.js && node --check src/workers/fast-parse-worker.js && node --check src/engine/fast-parser-core.js && node --check src/engine/verification-engine.js && node --check src/engine/power-taxonomy.js
scripts.test: pnpm syntax && node scripts/smoke-test.mjs && node scripts/parser-regression.mjs && node scripts/entity-ref-regression.mjs && node scripts/verification-regression.mjs && node scripts/scope-regression.mjs
